title: Claude + Canva = Cheat Code for Viral Carousels
description:
Claude plus Canva is a literal cheat code for creating carousels that got me thousands of followers.

#ai #canva #claude #socialmedia #contentcreator
transcript: Claude + Canva is a literal cheat code. Look at this. You can use it to create carousels that look like this. They got me thousands of followers. Go to the Claude desktop app, click on plus, connectors, add connectors, select Canva. From now on, you're able to do all of these things with Canva. Drop in this prompt so you can create designs, carousels, and emails that match your brand guidelines. Then drop this prompt so it creates a skill to automatically create carousels for you based on carousels you like. And the best thing is you can edit all of those layers inside of Canva directly. If you want the prompt so you can use Canva with Claude, just comment guide and I'll send it to you. Otherwise, make sure to follow for more videos like this.
